description: Active ART clients screened for TB at their last visit during the reporting quarter. Counts unique patients who are active on ART and whose last ART visit during the reporting quarter had a documented TB screening/status assessment.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE
    (
        (a.encounter_date >= :startDate
         AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY))
        OR a.return_visit_date > :endDate
    )

    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary s
        WHERE s.patient_id = a.patient_id
    )

    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_patients_latest_regimen r
        WHERE r.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND r.art_start_date IS NOT NULL
          AND r.art_start_date <= :endDate
    )

    AND a.encounter_date >= :startDate
    AND a.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
        WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
          AND x.encounter_date > a.encounter_date
          AND x.encounter_date < DATE_ADD(:endDate, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
    )

    AND a.tuberculosis_status IS NOT NULL;
